description: This is an abstract Java class named AbstractHeaderEntryFilter that provides a base implementation for filtering header entries in a protocol adapter context. It implements the HeaderEntryFilter interface, offering a common apply method and an abstract filterValue method for subclasses to define specific filtering behavior.

classes.name: AbstractHeaderEntryFilter
classes.description: An abstract class that provides a base implementation for HeaderEntryFilter, implementing a common apply method and requiring subclasses to implement specific value filtering logic.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Final method that applies filtering to a header entry; returns null if the value is null, otherwise delegates to filterValue.

methods.name: filterValue
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to define specific logic for filtering header values.
